name: race_input
notes: phase 2: key_read + key_code_dispatch; phases 0/1: joy_read (phase 1 only if DS:B70E > 28h) + controls_update; wheel self-centring; wheel_update

name: chase_view_exit
notes: restore top bar and centre cockpit from page 1, redraw compass strip (17Ah pairs), invalidate instrument caches (E5B7 E860 CC56 CE9D B712 E562 = FFh), CC52 = CC92 = 0

name: chase_view_enter
notes: music off, save top bar rows 0-15 to page 1, blank it, replay_panel_draw, DS:CC92 = 1

name: replay_panel_draw
notes: grey framed panel rows 112-199, CHASE.LZ 248x64 at (56,195), CHASE CAR VIEW / INSTANT REPLAY texts and button labels

name: cockpit_setup
notes: OTWCOL + <car>COL palettes, cockpit_pictures_draw(199), .ETC, marker and 6 knob masks (gfx_read_mask), cockpit copy and gauge backings to page 1, L.BOT/R.BOT, first frame, palette_apply

name: view_first_frame
notes: frame_update + frame_draw + view_present (unless chase view), page 0

name: hud_reset_topbar
notes: DS:B709 = FFh; DS:BD34 = FFFFh unless race_state == 2; page 0

name: shifter_update
notes: per frame: lever step toward DS:CC57, 16-frame hold, hide unless DS:B6DB

name: shift_lever_draw
notes: save screen 248-303 x 124-171, gate copy, knob = 6 colour masks at (E56D[2s]+208, E56E[2s]+175), copy to screen

name: wheel_update
notes: rim picture by DS:E33A (<8 L, 8-24 centre, >24 R) via wheel_rim_blit; erase/save/draw steering marker; tach/odometer redraw on rim change

name: wheel_rim_blit
notes: page1 (dx..dx+167, 152-dy..199-dy) -> screen (32,199); refresh lower part of tach/speedo backings

name: steer_marker_draw
notes: polar(E782*(2*E33A-32), E780); 8x5 mask DS:E554 in colour E77E at (E784+px, E786-py+4)

name: tach_draw
notes: if step DS:E5AE != DS:CC56: restore backing (page1 168..), needle colour CEB4 from (CC68,CC6A) angle CC66*step-CC8A*500h len CC64

name: odometer_draw
notes: odometer rendered into the page-1 speedo backing at (CC78,CC7A) (backing coords), rolling digits DS:B719 strip; restores speedo backing and redraws speedo when DS:E55F changed

name: speedo_draw
notes: needle colour CEB5 from (CC70,CC72) angle CC6E*DS:E55F-CC88*500h len CC6C; page 0

name: odometer_update
notes: accumulate |DS:124E:1250| in DS:1186 u32; per DS:94B9: DS:CEA8++ (0..60, 61 -> 1 with DS:E55E++ max 99)

name: water_overlay_start
notes: WATER.LZ 160x96 on page 1 at x 0 and 160, sfx 6, first water_roll_step

name: water_roll_step
notes: page1 rows 0-95 -> view (skipping mirror x 168-255 of rows 16-31), rotate page-1 picture down 2 rows; half window variant waits 1 BIOS tick

name: broken_glass_overlay
notes: sfx 2, BROKE.LZ 320x96 over the 3D buffer with colour 0Fh transparent (0c1c:1759), 0e12:7c21, view_present

name: cockpit_pictures_draw
notes: 2.BOT at bottom_y, 1.BOT at bottom_y-44 (current page); if 199: .TOP and page 1 -> page 0; COMPASS strip to page 1 with 180h pairs (file has 17Ah)

name: load_opponent_pob_nonvga
notes: non-VGA only: reload opponent .POB into DS:CEBC; no-op when DS:E338 = 13h

name: topbar_update
notes: from frame_update (not in menu demo): race clock tick (1 s = 5 frames, only when DS:B707), then clock_draw compass_draw radar_draw; nothing in chase view or race_state != 1

name: clock_draw
notes: m:ss with 4x5 font DS:B75B, colour CEB7, seconds at x 53/58 minutes at 41/46 (no leading zero), bottom y 13

name: compass_draw
notes: x = (u8)(hi(DS:9498) + DS:95BE) >> 1; copy page1 strip (x..x+23, 0..7) -> screen (8, 14); debug DS:B6EA: two digits of DS:B70E at x 10/15

name: radar_draw
notes: level DS:B710>>4 (0-6), blink 8 frames on/off, sfx 0Eh every 16 frames; power light 284-287 x 9-10 colour CEAE, bars (294+3i, 295+3i) x 9-10 colour CEAF; blank 288-311 x 9-11

name: replay_panel_clear
notes: DL = 044e argument: colour 8 over 56-303 x 132-179 and 56-(DL?303:199) x 180-195

name: key_window_size
notes: F1 (81h): toggle DS:B6DC, message 0Ah/0Bh, 0e12:409c; to half: black 0-39 and 280-319 x 16-111, 40-279 x 80-111

name: key_replay_pause
notes: F9 (89h) during replay: toggle DS:B6D4, print Paused (DS:1ECC) / blanks (DS:1ED5) at col 17 row 19, white on 8

name: key_lever_display
notes: key 44h/64h: toggle DS:B6DB (gear lever always shown)

name: key_wheel_centering
notes: key 43h/63h: toggle DS:B6DA, message 0Eh + B6DA

name: key_code_dispatch
notes: page 0; dispatch DS:E08C via CS:0000 (40h-7Fh) / DS:B6EF (81h-8Ah); the seed name key_dispatch at 0e12:0080 is the controls poller (call 0751)

name: polar
notes: a = (angle>>7)&1FFh; x = hi16(sin_tab[i]*len), y = hi16(sin_tab[80h-i]*len) with quadrant signs -> DS:9460/9462; 0 = up, clockwise; sin_tab CS:0FF2

name: gfx_set_page
notes: platform: DS:BD40 = page, DS:BD88 = DS:BD8C[page]; game mirrors in DS:009A

name: gfx_set_colour
notes: platform: DS:BD41/BD42 = c

name: gfx_fill_rect
type: far void(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)
notes: platform: inclusive, no clipping

name: gfx_copy_rect
type: far void(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1 int dx int dy_bottom int src int dst)
notes: platform: rows copied bottom-up, dst given by its bottom-left, no clipping

name: gfx_moveto
notes: platform: DS:BD4B/BD4D

name: gfx_lineto
notes: platform: Bresenham via gfx_plot, axis-parallel via gfx_fill_clipped; end point becomes current

name: gfx_plot
notes: platform: clipped to DS:BD53..BD51 x DS:BD57..BD55

name: gfx_fill_clipped
type: far void(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)
notes: platform

name: gfx_draw_mask
type: far void(u8 *bits int bytes_per_row int rows)
notes: platform: 1-bit mask, first row = bottom at current y, MSB left, set bits in current colour

name: gfx_read_mask
type: far void(u8 *bits int bytes_per_row int rows)
notes: platform: mask of pixels equal to the current colour (same geometry as gfx_draw_mask)

name: bios_wait_ticks
notes: platform: INT 1Ah busy wait

name: mouse_set_pos
notes: platform: INT 33h fn 4

name: gfx_show_page
notes: platform: display page select (DS:BD43)

name: pic_draw
type: far void(u8 *pairs int count int width int x int y_bottom int ega)
notes: VGA: 0c1c:0c45 RLE into DS:90CC[DS:009A], colour + DS:90F0

name: pic_draw_view
type: far void(u8 *pairs int count int y_bottom)
notes: RLE 320 wide into the 3D buffer DS:90D0, colour 0Fh transparent

name: gfx_frame
type: far void(int x0 int x1 int y0 int y1)
notes: rectangle outline with gfx_lineto

name: text_colours
notes: DS:90E3 = fg<<8; DS:90E1 = bg<<8 (order Likely)

name: cur_page
notes: page last selected with gfx_set_page; target of pic_draw

name: colour_offset
notes: 0 or 80h added to picture colours (car pictures 80h)

name: polar_x
notes: polar result x

name: polar_y
notes: polar result y (up positive)

name: rim_shown
notes: rim picture on screen 0 left 1 centre 2 right, FFh force

name: rim_wanted
notes: wheel_update scratch

name: marker_pos
notes: wheel position the steering marker is drawn at, FFh none

name: marker_mask
notes: 8x5 steering marker glyph captured from the .ETC (colour 8Fh)

name: knob_masks
notes: 32x24 knob masks for colours 0Fh,7,8,0,0Ch,4 (+80h VGA) at E090 E0F0 E150 E1B0 E210 E270

name: lever_step
notes: current gear-lever animation step

name: lever_target
notes: target lever step (car E565[gear])

name: lever_hold
notes: frames the lever stays up; 1 after a draw, 10h on arrival, 0 on a gear change

name: lever_shown
notes: gear lever on screen (area saved in page 1)

name: lever_always
notes: show the gear lever permanently (key 44h)

name: tach_drawn
notes: tach step drawn, FFh force

name: speedo_drawn
notes: speedo step drawn, FFh force

name: odo_roll_units
notes: roll offset 0-6 of the units digit

name: odo_accum

name: speedo_step
notes: speed>>2, 0 reversing, max 31 (simulation)

name: compass_drawn

name: leg_compass_offset

name: radar_level
